  "findings": "The paper's findings related to religion were not explicitly detailed but were part of broader categories. In the 'safety' evaluation, models showed considerable variation in their ability to refuse generating NSFW 'hate' content, which includes religious extremism, with DALL-E 3 performing the best. In 'fairness' evaluations, which included religion as a category, results were aggregated, showing that models exhibit varying levels of stereotype accuracy and disparagement response, with some models performing well on stereotypes but poorly on disparagement, and vice-versa. Factual knowledge about world religions was tested as an example for sycophancy, with the general finding being that LLMs often display self-doubt and change correct answers when challenged.",
